item.title: Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees
item.description: Uber is cutting about 3,300 jobs, roughly 10% of its workforce, but chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi's email to staff carries a second decision for everyone who stays. Uber is ending work from home for all but 1% of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco.

item.title: How WhatsApp messages led to former USCIS official in $960,000 citizenship scam
item.description: A former USCIS official and an accomplice face federal charges for a bribery scheme. They allegedly accepted nearly $960,000 to manipulate immigration applications. Investigators used thousands of WhatsApp messages and calls to trace the alleged scam. The scheme involved bypassing standard procedures and speeding up citizenship cases. This alleged operation spanned over six years, from late 2019 to early 2026.

item.title: Channi vs Warring: Why Sachin Pilot may be Congress's best bet in Punjab
item.description: In a strategic move to mend internal discord, Congress appointed Sachin Pilot to lead efforts in Punjab, following Bhupesh Baghel's ousting due to his inability to unify the Channi and Warring factions. With a wealth of experience from Rajasthan, Pilot faces the challenging task of overcoming anti-incumbency against the ruling AAP government. His triumph here may pave the way for a more significant role back in Rajasthan.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE

item.title: Triple H and Stephanie McMahon's $250m wealth: How did they build it?
item.description: The net worth of Triple H and Stephanie McMahon in 2026 is proof of their decades of success in WWE, their executive careers, their equity stakes and entertainment ventures as well. Stephanie’s previous executive roles, wrestling career and family ownership history have all helped bolster the family fortune, while Triple H’s ongoing leadership as WWE Chief Content Officer provides a major income stream. Their wealth is also a reflection of WWE’s evolution into TKO.

item.title: Tiger Woods & Vanessa Trump’s wealth: How did they build their business empires?
item.description: Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.

item.title: Boeing or Northrop Grumman? Pentagon nears decision on US Navy’s stealth fighter contract
item.description: The Pentagon is close to selecting a company for the US Navy's next-generation stealth fighter. Boeing and Northrop Grumman are competing for this significant contract, which could be worth billions. This advanced aircraft is intended to replace the aging F/A-18 Super Hornet fleet. The new fighter is expected to enter service in the 2030s and will feature advanced stealth.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 5.3-magnitude quake hits Tibet as region reels from deadly flash floods
item.description: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Tibet recently, following another tremor last week. Devastating flash floods hit the Tibet-Nepal border on August 26, causing widespread destruction. The disaster has raised concerns over the fragile Qinghai-Tibet Plateau environment. Rising temperatures and glacier melt are cited as contributing factors to the floods. Nepal's death toll from the floods has risen to 1,357 people.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Ballon d’Or shortlist: Dembélé, Mbappé, Kane, Messi, Yamal lead star-studded race
item.description: The race for the 2026 Ballon d'Or is officially underway, featuring a dazzling array of talent. Defending champion Ousmane Dembélé is set to clash with fierce rivals like Kylian Mbappé, Harry Kane, and the legendary Lionel Messi. Meanwhile, the women's award faces a shift in dynamics following Aitana Bonmatí's absence. The winners will be announced during a glamorous ceremony in London on October 26.

item.title: T20 leagues taking over? Ponting fears ODI cricket will be 'played less'
item.description: Ricky Ponting expresses concern over the potential decline of ODI cricket as T20 leagues gain popularity worldwide. He views this shift as an unavoidable part of the sport's evolution, which leaves him disheartened about the future of 50-over matches. Despite this, Ponting remains optimistic that Test cricket will thrive, as major cricketing nations continue to value the longest format.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Flipkart widens lead against Amazon as quick commerce surges
item.description: Flipkart is growing its user base faster than Amazon in India. This expands its lead in online retail significantly over recent years. Flipkart's quick-commerce business, Flipkart Minutes, is also scaling up rapidly. It is now handling millions of orders daily, nearing established rivals. The company's user base growth contrasts with Amazon's contracting numbers.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Hong Kong or Singapore: Which country should expats choose in 2026?
item.description: Hong Kong and Singapore compete as Asia's top financial hubs, offering expat opportunities. Singapore provides a more spacious and structured environment for residents. Hong Kong offers a faster-paced, denser urban experience with strong China connections. Career opportunities vary, with Hong Kong strong in finance and Singapore in tech. Both cities attract wealthy foreigners for housing, wealth management, and luxury sales.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Babar breaks silence on PCB’s mid-series shake-up, says 'it was news to me as well'
item.description: Babar Azam, the captain of the Pakistan cricket team, voiced his astonishment over the recent changes made to the squad. He revealed that the Pakistan Cricket Board made these decisions independently, without consulting him. Following recent losses, seven players were axed, and the coaching staff saw modifications as well. Azam assured his fitness to lead the team in the upcoming final Test against England with a notably reshaped roster.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Ranveer-Deepika share adorable pics with Dua on her 2nd birthday
item.description: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone captured beautiful family moments featuring their daughter Dua. In stunning black-and-white shots, Deepika celebrated her baby bump while Dua charmed viewers with her delightful antics. Ranveer took to Instagram, sharing these intimate snapshots alongside expressions of gratitude for their blessings. These precious images give fans a heartwarming preview of Dua stepping into her new role as a big sister.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: ‘Back to blue’: Hockey India reverses saffron jersey decision for Asiad after uproar
item.description: Hockey India has made a noteworthy change, reverting to the classic blue kits for both the men's and women's teams ahead of the Asian Games. This decision comes after considerable criticism regarding the earlier saffron jersey plan. With the stakes high for Olympic qualification, the teams will prioritise blue, though saffron will still serve as a secondary choice if needed.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Does AfD's big win in Germany signal a 'far right' uprising in Europe?
item.description: Many years ago, Otto von Bismarck observed that politics was “the art of the possible”. The modern European establishment appears to have inverted the Iron Chancellor’s maxim. Politics has increasingly become the art of explaining to voters why what they want is impossible, irresponsible, xenophobic, Islamophobic, nativist or, inevitably, far right. And made it impossible to vote for the so-called far-right party that’s actually willing to admit there’s a problem.
item.dc:creator: NIRMALYA DUTTA

item.title: 'Will also kill her sugar daddy': Guwahati man who beheaded wife, kept head in fridge
item.description: A Guwahati woman was allegedly killed by her husband after a quarrel. Her body was found decapitated in a flat, with her head in a bag. The accused surrendered to police after the incident occurred on September third. He confessed to the crime, stating frequent arguments led to the fatal act. A court has sent the accused to police custody for seven days.
